findings.evidence: Before repair, an all-equal100-row ranking with50 positives gives precision0.1 or0.9 after reversing the same labels. A mixed boundary-tie test gives0.8 instead of expected0.6 for three of five permutations. Initial regression run:5failed/3passed in3.33s.
findings.impact: An uninformative/tied head can appear better or worse depending on dataset order, biasing internal validation and later challenger/incumbent comparison. No actual missed trade or profit is inferred.
findings.repair: Select all rows strictly above the cutoff and allocate only the remaining rounded-k slots equally across the whole exact-score boundary group. Precision and recall share this calculation.

findings.evidence: Previous artifacts and unchanged-dataset cache did not identify the tie-handling metric generation or the configured top-k fraction.
findings.impact: Old row-order metrics could be consumed or skip a fresh evaluation after the definition changes.
findings.repair: Record expected_boundary_ties_v1, bump advisory pipeline7to8, include the ranking version and fraction in its fingerprint, require the current generation for internal/later comparison and scalar/batch ranking, and reject incompatible rollback heads. Retain original legacy artifacts.

contract.selection: k=max(1,round(n*clamp(fraction,0,1))); preserve original rounded capacity for strictly ordered scores.
contract.ties: For cutoff c, select all score>c rows and assign (k-count(score>c))/count(score=c) to every boundary row. No label-dependent choice, row-order tie-break, score rounding or random execution is introduced.
contract.measures: Precision=expected true positives/k; recall=expected true positives/all observed positives, unknown when no positives. Invalid binary truth, shapes or nonfinite fraction remain unknown; nonfinite predictions are excluded diagnostically, and cannot yield complete ranking validation.
contract.lineage: Current trained metadata includes the method version, row grain, k/fraction, cutoff, complete boundary size/weight and expected true positives. This is a definition discriminator, not independent execution attestation.
contract.learned_lifecycle: A checked successor must independently pass current internal/later evidence before replacing an incompatible incumbent. Original artifacts are preserved and never filled with retrospectively manufactured approvals.

contract.trading: No new buy veto or permission, threshold relaxation, financial acceptance, sizing or exit change. Exact0.1SOL PAPER and uncapped residual upside with risk/holding protections remain.
